description: A firm with a whale customer — one customer carries most of the revenue. Tests concentration reporting without slipping into causal language.

at_risk.definition: customers with 2+ lifetime visits whose last visit is 45-180 days before period end

good:
## Summary
Whale Boutique had one very large customer this month. Revenue was SGD 10,000.00, and Chen H. alone carried 85.0% of it.

## What went well
- 7 of 8 customers this month had already bought before, a returning-customer share of 87.5%.
- 100% of revenue came from identified customers.

## What needs attention
- Chen H. carried SGD 8,500.00, or 85.0% of all revenue. That concentration is a strength and a risk: losing this customer would hurt badly.
- 1 regular has not been seen in a while. One returned visit is worth SGD 20.00.

## Your customers
Chen H. is by far your largest customer, at 85.0% of revenue.

## Do these three things next
1. Send one win-back message to the 1 at-risk regular this week. SGD 20.00 / 1 customer = SGD 20.00 each.
2. Build a second relationship with another customer so Chen H. is not the only large account.
3. Check in personally with Chen H. next month to keep the relationship strong.
